suspicions.claim: The POST /api/posts endpoint now returns HTTP 200 instead of 201 on successful post creation.
suspicions.trigger: Send POST /api/posts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON body {"text": "test post"}. Read the HTTP status code from the response; it will be 200 instead of the previous 201.
suspicions.evidence: Probe probe_s1 sent POST /api/posts with valid auth and body; base answered 201, head answered 200.
